# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`.
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
License: MIT (see `qrcode.LICENSE.txt`).

The pinned npm development dependency allows verifying or updating this copy.
The website uses the vendored file, so QR generation makes no external requests.
